# AsePad

> AsePad is a decentralized launchpad and DeFi exchange on the Asentum blockchain. It is a crypto/DeFi platform - not stock trading, not a broker.

AsePad lets anyone create ARC-20 tokens, launch them on bonding curves (fair launches), trade on AseDex (the on-chain DEX with markets, terminal, pools, limit orders and wallet portfolio), lock LP/tokens/vesting with AseLock, and use AseVault as the Asentum wallet app. Everything is fully on-chain; LP is burned forever at migration.

## Sections
- Launches (bonding-curve tokens): https://pump.asepad.fun/
- Create a token: https://create.asepad.fun/
- AseDex exchange + terminal: https://asedex.asepad.fun/
- Token/LP/vesting locks (AseLock): https://locks.asepad.fun/
- Documentation: https://docs.asepad.fun/
- AseVault wallet + security audit: https://asevault.asepad.fun/
- Policies: https://policy.asepad.fun/privacy
- API: https://api.asepad.fun/api/
